naming-pattern: Resolve current rules through references/convention-resolution.md. A matching project override wins; unmentioned rules inherit from this file.
Root holds only always-read control files; everything else lives in one lifecycle folder.
Field separator is underscore _; words within a field use hyphen -. Order fields general->specific: [type]_[area]_[specifics].

Use numbers only where they encode order or durable workflow keys. Gaps are acceptable once referenced; duplicates/collisions and competing numbering systems are errors. Prefer area/purpose labels when numbers add no information.
[area] = a functional area/module within the project (ordering, invoicing, delivery), not the project name.
[specifics] = the particular subject (customer-order-form, data-model). Drop area/specifics when the remaining fields already pin it down.
Fixed-name files keep their conventional name (no pattern). Add a date only to genuine point-in-time artifacts.

Human-readable developer-Claude workflow documents default to Markdown (.md). Use structured or interactive formats only when the artifact requires them, such as YAML for machine-managed state, CSV for compact registries, or HTML for interactive visual references.

Sidecars/companions share the parent doc's basename: {parent-basename}.{role}.{ext} (for example prd.decision-log.md, brief.addendum.md, ux.color-themes.html). They are not separate rows; they live beside their parent.

Every recurring durable document type has one row, whether a skill or workflow writes it (for example agent-pm PRD -> prd) or Claude authors it directly. organise-docs owns convention design; upskill updates affected skill consumers.
forge-[slug]/ (folder exception: holds optional forged-idea.md, forge-report.html, and hidden .memlog.md; do NOT flatten)
ux-[area]/ (folder exception: holds fixed-name DESIGN.md + EXPERIENCE.md plus companions such as .decision-log.md and .working/ notes; do NOT flatten)
